description: This file defines the HistoryPanel class, which provides methods to interact with the calculator application's history panel and flyout in UI automation tests, including opening panels, retrieving history items, and resizing the window to ensure UI elements are visible.

classes.name: HistoryPanel
classes.description: A class providing automation methods for interacting with the calculator application's history panel and flyout, including opening, clearing, and resizing UI elements.

methods.name: OpenHistoryPanel
methods.description: Opens the history panel by resizing window and clicking the history label.

methods.name: GetAllHistoryListViewItems
methods.description: Retrieves all history items listed in the history panel.

methods.name: ClearHistory
methods.description: Opens the history panel and clicks the clear history button if visible.

methods.name: ResizeWindowToDisplayHistoryLabel
methods.description: Resizes the window to ensure the history label is visible.

methods.name: ResizeWindowToDisplayHistoryButton
methods.description: Resizes the window to ensure the history button is visible.

methods.name: OpenHistoryFlyout
methods.description: Opens the history flyout by resizing window, focusing calculator, sending keystrokes, and moving the mouse.

methods.name: GetAllHistoryFlyoutListViewItems
methods.description: Retrieves all history items listed in the flyout.

methods.name: GrowWindowToShowHistoryLabel
methods.description: Recursively increases window width until the history label is visible or maximum width is reached.

methods.name: ShrinkWindowToShowHistoryButton
methods.description: Recursively decreases window width until the history button is visible or minimum width is reached.
